TASK BRIEF: Fetch a specific payment refund, but cannot issue a refund (Razorpay)

FIT
Not at all. The supplied request only retrieves details for an existing refund; it does not create or issue a refund for a payment. Try a Razorpay refund-creation endpoint or search again for an API request that issues refunds. The supplied fetch-refund request is not relevant to the stated task.
